**Klynge VEST** is a healthcare cluster (sundhedsklynge) operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] in Denmark [^src3][^src5]. It is one of the local organizational units monitored in the national quality assurance program for the treatment of [[atrieflimren]], as detailed in the annual "Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark" (AFDK) reports published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP) [^src1][^src8].

The cluster's clinical performance is evaluated across several quality indicators. For [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]], which measures the timely initiation of [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] for newly diagnosed patients, Klynge VEST has demonstrated strong compliance. In the 2024 report, the cluster achieved a result of 93.7%, successfully meeting the standard [^src1]. In the subsequent 2025 report, it recorded a rate of 91.4% [^src8]. Nationally, 17 out of 22 clusters managed to fulfill the development goal of ≥90% ([[udviklingsmaal-90-percent|Udviklingsmål ≥ 90%]]) for this metric [^src8]. Looking at an earlier period (July 1, 2018, to June 30, 2019), the proportion of atrial fibrillation patients in Klynge VEST who received anticoagulation therapy was 83.1% [^src3].

Beyond treatment initiation, Klynge VEST is tracked for adverse clinical outcomes and long-term complications. For newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients in the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the cluster reported that 4.4% developed severe bleeding within one year, a metric tracked under [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]] [^src6]. During the exact same timeframe, 4.7% of newly diagnosed patients in the cluster developed heart failure within one year, monitored as [[indikator-15|Indikator 15]] [^src6]. 

The AFDK reports also subject Klynge VEST to extensive supplementary analyses, comparing its outcomes—such as 1-year and 2-year treatment coverage, incidence of ischemic stroke, intracranial hemorrhage, and mortality—against regional and national benchmarks to identify variations in clinical practice and patient outcomes [^src2][^src4][^src5][^src7][^src9][^src10][^src11].

### clinical-outcome
- I perioden 01.07.2018–30.06.2019 var andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog antikoagulationsbehandling, i Klynge VEST 83,1 % (95 % CI: 73,3–90,5) [^src1] (klynge-vest, atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)

### clinical-indicator
- For Klynge VEST var andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som udviklede alvorlig blødning inden for 1 år, 4,4 % (95 % CI: 2,3–7,5) i perioden 01.07.2022–30.06.2023 [^src1] (indikator-11, klynge-vest)
